submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best simulated resolution (2.95% at 5 cm, versus 3.14% at 3 cm and 3.33% at 8 cm). K1 gives 4.29% at 5 cm and K2 8.5% in the 2025 summary. The project documents contain no radiopurity data for any candidate, so low-background suitability is unverified. I did not simulate 2, 4, 6, 7, 9 or 10 cm, so 5 cm is the best of the thicknesses I tried and not a confirmed optimum. Before purchase, get intrinsic-activity assay data from the vendor for K3, because many high-light-yield scintillators have intrinsic radioactivity. If K3 fails that check, K1 is the fallback.

requirements.evidence: K3 2.95% at 5 cm (simulated). K1 4.29% at 5 cm. K2 8.5% (2025 summary).
No document gives intrinsic radioactivity for any crystal. The shielding castle and radon purge are installed, but they do not address contamination inside the crystal.
